answer: We model a Sybil-resistant mechanism where each node deposits staking collateral verified by a zero-knowledge delay kernel. The opportunity cost of identity multiplication scales non-linearly, driving expected attack utility below zero. Any adversarial division of stake triggers a subgame-perfect slashing penalty, flattening the payoff landscape into a loss-bearing mesa. Implementing the walnut protocol for validation, the game theoretic formulation guarantees that honest participation is the unique, strict Nash equilibrium.
